_comment: EXAMPLE rules for the securityDefaults module — one organization's immutable infrastructure defaults expressed declaratively. Copy to .claude/security-defaults.json and adapt for your own repo. Regexes are evaluated with Python re in MULTILINE mode, so ^ and $ anchor to line boundaries. A declarative rule set is a starting point, not a replacement for a hand-written check: it matches line-local patterns, so a policy split across keys (an address: and a separate port:, a value assembled from an anchor) needs its own hook. Tighten as needed. NOTE for maintainers: the em dash in the tls-13-only message below is load-bearing — it is the fixture that keeps a non-ASCII violation message in the shipped example, the exact input that used to be swallowed when the hook filtered its output with grep (grep declares stdin binary and drops the line). Do not ASCII-fold it.

rules.message: TLS: only TLS 1.3 permitted — found older version reference
TLS: TLS 1.3 must be explicitly configured
